whyCanary8sRemainingRuleIsUnsound: Canary #8's rule was 'all caps + no clause punctuation + no determiner or pronoun'. Its stated justification was that a proposition needs arguments and an argument is introduced by a determiner. That inference has a hole the rule cannot see: A PREDICATION WHOSE ARGUMENTS ARE BARE NOUNS HAS NO DETERMINER TO FIND. 'BORROWER SHALL PAY INTEREST' and 'COMPANY DELIVERS REPORTS' are both subject-verb-object with zero determiners. The absence of a determiner is therefore not positive evidence of anything - it is the absence of one particular clue, and canary #8 shipped it as proof. The rule was necessary but never sufficient, which is exactly why the counterexample was pinned rather than hidden.

architecturalRuleChosen.question: What independent structural evidence actually proves this source is a heading?
architecturalRuleChosen.investigation: computeSourceCoverage receives SourceContextRegion. Its sourceNodeId and sectionRef describe the WHOLE region, not the line. No per-fragment heading or caption metadata reaches the classifier. segmentSourceUnits reports where units begin and end, not what they are. The structural index does distinguish heading-only nodes (reference-resolver.ts DEGENERATE_TEXT_CHARS), but that signal is not plumbed into coverage, and plumbing it is a larger change than this mission authorises.
architecturalRuleChosen.answer: At this layer, none exists. Deterministic structure cannot positively distinguish 'NEGATIVE COVENANTS' from 'BORROWER SHALL PAY INTEREST'.
architecturalRuleChosen.decision: Per §5, do not pretend it can. The ALL-CAPS suppression is REMOVED OUTRIGHT - ALLCAPS_FRAME_RE, DETERMINERS and isAllCapsNominalHeading are deleted, not patched with a further lexical exception. Typography now grants nothing at all.
architecturalRuleChosen.whatSuppressionStillRequires: a frame independent of casing - a bare citation (CITATION_ONLY), a numbered caption whose remainder is a name (canary #7), a quoted defined-term name (canary #5), pagination or a table-of-contents leader (canary #6). All verified unchanged.
architecturalRuleChosen.noVerbList: No SHALL / MUST / MAY / WILL / PAY / MAKE / DELIVER / INCUR / MAINTAIN, no covenant-family terms, no BORROWER or INTEREST special case. The fix removes a rule; it adds no vocabulary.
architecturalRuleChosen.noLength: no min or max characters, no token thresholds, no short-phrase logic. Two permanent assertions hold both directions: a short all-caps fragment and a 109-character all-caps nominal now receive the same conservative default.

corpusImpact.measurementCorrection: An initial sweep appeared to show all 45 scenarios newly surfacing an unaccounted ALL-CAPS article heading. That sweep was wrong and is recorded rather than quietly dropped: it fed scenario.text - the whole synthetic agreement including the ARTICLE VII / NEGATIVE COVENANTS preamble - as the coverage region. The compiler never does that. resolveSourceContext extends to the anchoring unit, so the real operative region begins at the numbered caption ('SECTION 7.06 Investments. ...'), and the ALL-CAPS preamble never reaches computeSourceCoverage at all. Verified directly through buildScenario: I1, I5 and I35 all report unaccounted 0 with no gap re-inventory attempted, and their single HEADING_OR_LABEL span is the numbered caption, which this canary does not touch.
